claim: In the same two-dimensional active-noise model, at area fractions 0.1 and 0.4, the static structure factor depends on the noise only through the correlation length lambda_a and the second length va*tau_a: changing va and tau_a with their product held fixed leaves the structure factor unchanged and only makes the particles move faster or slower.
validity_conditions: A MODEL RESULT. Repulsive WCA disks (cutoff 2^(1/6) sigma), overdamped, each displaced by the potential force plus the local value of a Gaussian noise field correlated over lambda_a in space and tau_a in time with magnitude va, standing in for an active fluid; no separate thermal noise; HOOMD-blue (version not stated) with the authors' noise generator; box 200 x 200 and grid spacing 0.5 in reduced units (sigma, epsilon, t0 = gamma sigma^2/epsilon), time step 1e-4, 250 time units, 50 independent runs. The authors call the model highly simplified and not expected to be quantitatively accurate. The noise parameters are in reduced units the registry cannot express and so appear here in words only. Shown at two-dimensional area fractions 0.1 and 0.4 (the Fig. 6 insets, with further cases in the Supplemental Information). For a single tracer the paper also reports that in the limit of infinite correlation length the particle becomes an active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particle with persistence time tau_a and diffusivity va^2 tau_a.
